about: BrewDadLabs projects. To add one, add one entry to this list. Status is live, growing or workshop. Links are optional. Keep each line to one plain, true sentence.

projects.name: The Arcade
projects.description: Four retro terminal games that run in your browser, free with no ads, trackers or accounts.

projects.name: StinkDoku
projects.description: A logic puzzle game I made as a gift for my wife, free forever, ad-free and with no monetization; open source is planned.

projects.name: Gorillas 404
projects.description: A remake of the 1991 QBasic Gorillas game that turns a missing page into a banana fight; it is the 404 page on dixhome.com, and a reusable version for our other sites is on the way.

projects.name: NewEarth Wildlife
projects.description: A plug-in that brings dinosaur wildlife to the Lost World on our family Minecraft server, starting with the Compsognathus; first release in progress, more details coming.

projects.name: NewEarth
projects.description: Our family Minecraft server and its website.

projects.name: Self-hosted systems
projects.description: The home servers and network that run the workshop, including a self-hosted search engine and our own dynamic DNS.

projects.name: Hevy integration
projects.description: A personal helper that reads my workout history from the Hevy app through its API.

projects.name: Genealogy tools
projects.description: Scripts that import GEDCOM family-tree files into a local database for our family history research.
